Evan - Events: Heads-up: Summit Satellite in SF on Jun 7. We have a 6ft table, 30-min demo slot at 14:00, expected ~140. Need final: swag mix, speaker quick blurb, QR -> HubSpot routing.
Nina (Marketing): I'll write the blurb. Quick poll: focus demo on API integration or cost benchmarks?
Omar - Growth: API integration wins for this crowd. Include one benchmark stat as social proof.
Rae (Design): Swag options ready: 140 stickers, 75 tees, 80 microfiber cloths, 50 enamel pins. Ops recommend 75 shirts to avoid excess.
Evan - Events: Lock shirts 75, stickers 140, cloths 80, pins 40. Ship window Jun 7 17:30 pickup.
Nina (Marketing): Webinar follow-up date: Jun 21. QR opt-in should add leads to HubSpot and tag "satellite_sf". Who will set the workflow?
Omar - Growth: I'll build workflow. Rule: score >= 20 -> assign SDR, else add to nurture with webinar invite. Use utm_source=sat_sf&utm_medium=qr.
packaging-bot: Shipping label created. Pickup scheduled Jun 7 17:30, tracking TRK123SAT.
